# OFF AXIS

> OFF AXIS is an independent strategy, audience, experience and growth advisory helping organisations in sport, outdoor and culture find new lines of growth.

Founder: Joseph Villeflayoux
Based in: South of France, working internationally

**Expertise**

- Audiences, insights and positioning
- Brand, narrative and experience
- Partnerships, revenue and value
- Teams, activation and delivery

OFF AXIS combines strategy, project structuring, stakeholder alignment and execution to move opportunities through to delivery.

**Playing fields**

- Events and rights holders
- Destinations and resorts
- Sport, outdoor and lifestyle brands
- Leagues and federations

**Background**

Joseph Villeflayoux has twenty years of experience across sport, outdoor, media, brands and destinations. His background includes VP Marketing at Hurricane Group (FISE), Head of Communications at the Freeride World Tour (FIS), consulting work with Olympic institutions and organising committees across Tokyo 2020 and Paris 2024, and more than 500 events and activations.
